answer: One agent spends 27 minutes and is done; the farm spends 11205 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. One proof settles it, and it reads Pewter trimmer brass proof poured at the finishing bench, spelled out in full as each brass is a pouring record witnessed by the master pewterer. One walnut proves a maker, one trellis proves a payment, one prism proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint.
